commands_used: answer 1. I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka, the order of the Xeech-Leel, who want to find the Eye of Argonia before the Unbound (Cuts-the-Old-Knot) do, because the Hist trees are sickening. The map from Vicrium led me to the Grey Tooth, the seamark of Skeith Isle, where the Collector (Ennodius Vanin) has hired men camped and digging in a cave. 2. Find what the Collector men found in the Grey Tooth Cave, on its north face. 3. Fight the three hirelings, or sneak past them (my build favours sneaking) to the cave door; also there is Vanins Rubbing here to look at. 4. I do not fully understand what the Collector is after here or what the rubbing shows; I can read the rubbing and look in the cave to find out.

answer 1. The cave niche is empty; the Collector rubbing says the stone was shipped off on the Stormwidow by her captain 181, and the ship lies on the south-west beach of Skeith Isle. The Collector has sold her name to diggers. I still work for the Toh-Reel-Ka hunting the Eye before the Unbound. 2. Go to the Wreck of the Stormwidow, south-west shore, and search the hold for the kings stone. 3. Fight whoever is there or sneak past; the marker points to the hold door and a ballast crate. 4. I do not know what the kings stone is exactly or what it does; presumably another key toward the Root. I would learn by finding it.

answer 1. I took the Kings Marker Stone from the ballast crate before the Unbound scouts. It shows seven towers in water, one cut deeper; it likely ties to the seven-tower map from Vicrium and the way to the Root and the Eye. The scouts had the seal recipe (grey caps and dried root paste). 2. Speak to the wounded scout Tah-Leesh below the bow of the Stormwidow. 3. Talk to her, or fight the Unbound scouts, or leave; I prefer to talk. 4. I do not know which of the seven towers is the deep-cut one or where the towers are; maybe Tah-Leesh or the order knows.

answer 1. Tah-Leesh, a wounded Unbound scout abandoned by her fellows, said Cuts-the-Old-Knot tells anyone serving the Toh-Reel-Ka to ask what moans in the cellar of Fort Chalkmoth, the Archwardens fort on the Chixathe Mesa. It hints the order hides something, maybe related to Nesh-Deekas knowledge of the Unbound. 2. Bring the Kings Marker Stone to Never-Writes-Twice in Nesh-Deeka House, Helstrom. 3. Go straight back as ordered, or first investigate Fort Chalkmoth cellar myself; I can also ask Never-Writes-Twice about the moaning. 4. I do not understand what moans in Fort Chalkmoth cellar, or why the Unbound leader says it about the order. I could ask Never-Writes-Twice or go look.

answer 1. The marker stone shows seven drowned spires off Lilmoth on the sea floor of Benthic Yobesh, one marked deeper; Never-Writes-Twice took the stone and paid me 100 gold. The quest The Grey Tooth is complete. Never-Writes-Twice brushed off the Fort Chalkmoth rumour, which makes me a little suspicious. 2. Go by boat from Lilmoth to Bell Station and ask its divers which tower is the marked one; or first visit Fort Chalkmoth on the Chixathe Mesa above Noota Nara. 3. Bell Station first as the order wishes, or Chalkmoth first to see who moans in the cellar. 4. I do not know what moans in the cellar, nor which tower is marked; the divers at Bell Station should know.

answer Notes: The Grey Tooth is done. The Grey Tooth cave niche was empty. The Collector (Vanin) rubbing sent me to the wreck of the Stormwidow on Skeith Isle SW beach, where I took the Kings Marker Stone from a ballast crate ahead of Unbound scouts. I read their seal recipe: grey caps plus dried root ground into a numbing paste, a thumbs weight per tree. Wounded scout Tah-Leesh said Cuts-the-Old-Knot tells servants of the Toh-Reel-Ka to ask what moans in the cellar of Fort Chalkmoth (Chixathe Mesa above Noota Nara). I gave the stone to Never-Writes-Twice in Helstrom; she said the seven towers are drowned spires off Lilmoth in Benthic Yobesh, and the divers of Bell Station (islet east of Lilmoth, boat from Lilmoth) know which is the marked one. She paid 100 gold and dismissed the Chalkmoth rumour as wind, which I distrust, given Nesh-Deeka always knows too much about the Unbound. I no longer hold the stone. Next: Bell Station for the hunt, or Fort Chalkmoth cellar first. I am Toh-Wo.
